firm_data.firm_description: Mintz & Gold was founded in 1993 to provide its clients the highest quality legal representation at a fair and reasonable cost. The firm provides legal advice and counsel to clients from New York City and the tri-state area, and throughout the United States.
notable_facts: 17 attorneys named to the 2025 New York Super Lawyers list, including 4 Rising Stars

email.subject: AI for Mintz & Gold, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Steven,

Mintz & Gold's 30+ year track record of delivering high-quality representation at fair costs across the tri-state area and beyond is exactly the kind of efficient, client-focused operation that benefits most from AI built for lean teams.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform designed for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner resources. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters for smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to share how our ex-lawyer team is helping practices compete with BigLaw without compromising quality.

Worth 20 minutes to explore?

Vasu
Lucio
